players.name: Yann Kamagate
players.age_note: Turns 18 on Sept 30 2026 per SI (so born 2008-09-30, derived)
players.notes: Potential reclass to 2027 (SI thinks likely); would still be 2028 draft-eligible if so. ESPN had him No.5 in May, No.1 Aug 27. Projected draft year is 2029 only if he stays in class 2028.

players.name: Joaquim Boumtje Boumtje

reclassifications: Marcus Spears Jr. (was 2027 No.1 ESPN): reclassed to 2026, signed with Texas Jul 10 2026; 2027 draft candidate, not 2028.
Joaquim Boumtje Boumtje and Nikola Kusturica: reclassed 2027 to 2026, now Duke and UCLA freshmen; 2028 draft candidates.
Adan Diggs: ESPN says moved up from 2028 into 2027.
Colton Hiller and Yann Kamagate (2028 class): both reportedly considering reclass to 2027 (not final).
mock_drafts: No 2028 or 2029 full mock draft was reachable. Only ESPN's Aug 20 2026 early-watch piece (Boumtje first, then Kusturica as the 2028 names) and a 2027 FanSided board exist in sources.
unreachable: ESPN SC Next 100 full pages (404), On3/Rivals rankings (403), nbadraft.net (403), 247 2027 ranks 51-60 (needs Load More).
